@graph.headline: Otter vs Fireflies vs Fathom: A 2026 Guide for US Teams
@graph.description: Otter ai vs Fireflies ai vs Fathom in 2026: free plans, prices per seat, CRM sync, recording limits and privacy compared for US teams, with a clear verdict.

itemListElement.name: Otter vs Fireflies vs Fathom: A 2026 Guide for US Teams

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter is better for live transcripts and individual use. Fireflies is better for teams that want CRM sync, topic tracking and search across calls. Price is close: $8.33 versus $10 a month on annual billing. Run both on the same 3 meetings before deciding.

mainEntity.name: Which is cheaper, Fireflies or Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter is cheaper on annual billing ($8.33 versus $10 for the entry plan). On monthly billing Otter Pro costs $16.99 and Fireflies Pro costs $18. Fathom's free plan is cheaper than both if you only need recording. Annual billing saves the most.

mainEntity.name: Is Fathom better than Otter and Fireflies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fathom has the best free plan of the three, with unlimited recordings and transcripts. Fireflies has deeper integrations, and Otter has live transcripts. Fathom is the best starting point for people who do not want to pay. Upgrade when you need CRM sync.

Fireflies offers video recording on its Business plan and above. Fathom records video on its free plan. Otter focuses on audio and transcripts. Fathom's free video makes it easy to share short clips with colleagues who missed a call, which neither Otter nor Fireflies offers for free.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Otter, Fireflies or Fathom without a bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fireflies has a desktop app that records system audio without a bot, and Fathom offers bot-free capture in beta. Otter relies on its meeting agent. Lynkk records without a bot through its Mac app and Chrome extension. Tell attendees either way.

mainEntity.name: Which works best with Microsoft Teams?

acceptedAnswer.text: All three join Microsoft Teams meetings. Fireflies and Otter join as participants; Fathom does too. If your company prefers built-in tools, Teams' own AI recap requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.
